name: han-cross-agent-skill-transfer-benchmark-dataset-v1
description:
Humanoid Cross-Agent Skill Transfer Benchmark Dataset
	

This dataset benchmarks how effectively
skills learned by one humanoid agent
can be transferred to another agent
within a decentralized cognitive network.

	
		
		Objective
	

To measure cross-agent generalization,
adaptation speed, and transfer efficiency.

	
		
		Data Fields
	


source_agent_skill_profile
target_agent_initial_profile
transferred_skill_vector
adaptation_steps
performance_improvement_percentage… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/achiepatricia/han-cross-agent-skill-transfer-benchmark-dataset-v1.
reputation: Niche, early-stage dataset hosted on Hugging Face for humanoid skill-transfer research with limited community adoption so far.
